!

!
device GigaEthernet1
!

  vlan-group 1 port 1 2
  vlan-group 2 port 3 4
  port 3 speed 100
  port 3 duplex full
  port 4 shutdown
!

  ip address 203.0.113.2/30
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  no ip address
  no shutdown
!

  no shutdown
!

  ip address 192.0.2.1/25
  no shutdown

interface GigaEthernet2:2.0
